symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1489 (ako/mxcli#1345): under `mdl 1;` an activity with `on error [without rollback] begin … end error` could not be changed in place. `create or modify` with one call argument changed (or only the handler's log text) was refused and advised `alter`; the advised `alter … replace` was refused with 'cannot replace the ActionActivity at (360, 200): it has an error handler, which would be left with no activity; rewrite the flow with create or modify instead'
cause: mfmutator removable() refused any drop or replace of an activity with an outgoing error flow, whatever the replacement; create or modify reached the same refusal because patchDiff treated the handler body as part of the activity (a change inside the handler became a replace of the call), and lcsStatements did not pair such an activity, so a neighbouring change merged with it
file: mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (replaceKeepingHandler, swapInPlace, serializeInPlace, removable), mdl/executor/flow_splice_error_handler.go (sameHandlerShell, handlerEdit, keepStoredHandler, storedStatementAt), mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go (gap, lcsStatements), mdl/executor/cmd_alter_flow.go (applyTo), mdl/ast/ast_alter_flow.go (KeepHandler)
fix: Replace of a top-level activity with a custom handler by ONE activity whose action has the same ErrorHandlingType is an in-place swap (shared with replaceInLoop): same collection slot, stored position and size, every flow in/out — the error flow included — repointed; the handler's activities and rejoin merge untouched. create or modify pairs same-kind activities with the same handler kind, replaces the activity with KeepHandler when it changed, and diffs the handler body like an if branch. alter recognises a restated handler by comparing with the stored statement from the full-layout describe (sameIgnoringLayout) and strips the fragment to its entry activity; another handler is refused with advice to address the handler's activities by handle. Remaining refusals name drop-and-create, never create or modify
test: mfmutator splice_handler_test.go TestSplice_ReplaceKeepsTheErrorHandler (byte-exact expected unit), TestSplice_ReplaceOfAHandledActivityRefusals; executor flow_splice_error_handler_pedapp_test.go TestCreateOrModify_ActivityWithErrorHandlerIsSplicedInPlace (T1, T3, both, T4 returning handler; ids/positions kept, re-run Unchanged, control: handler kind change refused), TestAlter_ReplaceOfActivityWithErrorHandler (T2; refusals not circular). Source reverted: every subtest fails with 'rewrite the flow with create or modify instead'
insight: Two refusals that each advise the other mode are a sign the shared primitive refuses too broadly: the mutator refused on the presence of an error flow instead of asking whether the replacement keeps it valid (one activity, same custom ErrorHandlingType). The handler body is just more top-level nodes — diffing it like an if branch was enough for T3. The fake serializer in splice_test.go had no Action/ErrorHandlingType, so it had to grow one before the mutator test could express the case
